description: This file defines the interface INativeJS within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, which provides virtual methods for managing NativeJS plugins and applications, including initialization, creation, execution, and termination.

classes.name: INativeJS
classes.description: A virtual interface for managing NativeJS applications and plugins within the WPEFramework, providing methods for initialization, creation, execution, and termination of applications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NativeJS plugin with the specified Wayland display.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the NativeJS plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new NativeJS application with specified options and returns its ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs an existing NativeJS application identified by its ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code within a NativeJS application identified by its ID.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves details of all existing NativeJS applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates a running NativeJS application by its ID.
